scope: Twelve fresh processes per version/scenario, 32 MiB old-space. First load of a previously unseen song with unrelated existing lyrics/translations occupying 48,000-60,000 cache characters. Playback metadata/palette for the new song is supplied only when seed=true. No HTTP latency. Output hashes and request counts must match the baseline. Both versions use this one fixture codec; only native runtimes differ. Samples at invocation, HTTP and completion boundaries; not a phone/VPN peak or every allocation.
